adapter_candidates.dependency: lee-kb package import into consumer runtime
adapter_candidates.reason: no satisfied GATE-DEP-001 entry exists; candidate never installed or trialled

current_receipts_persisted_per_call.detail: persisted current receipts after two identical wire queries: 2

mapping_hash_matches_consumer_algorithm.detail: owner mapping hash equals the consumer's canonical sha256 of the same body

no_write_holds.detail: source corpus digests identical across sync + retrieve + history

owner_seam_recovery_surface.detail: the owner seams expose no timeout/cancel surface; REC-08 timeout, cancel and process recovery remain consumer-side and unproven in this repository

wire_history_release_capable.detail: kb_history_get releases one exact object with a complete receipt and answers every withheld basis identically; missing wire receipt fields: none

wire_identity_is_mapped.detail: kb_search identity is the versioned OwnerIdentityMapping, and the receipt binds its version and hash; the configured owner is ignored

wire_owner_handshake_exposed.detail: initialize serverInfo.owner publishes every owner version and the mapping hash, so wire-side drift is detectable; missing fields: none

wire_receipt_keys_within_consumer_allowl.detail: every additive receipt name the wire emits is normalized by the consumer; outside the allowlist: none

wire_required_tools_present.detail: initialize + tools/list expose kb_search and kb_history_get

contract_rows.requirement: owner-native tests complete before the Core adapter
version/schema/corpus/identity/permission handshake complete before the Core adapter
field/receipt/freshness/recovery parity for current and exact history
exact immutable server-side mapping of Core principal lee to lee-kb lee@leebase.com
clients and delegates cannot send principal or groups
clients cannot widen project, source, root, path or item, or broaden filters
multi-project access requires an explicit grant and separate receipts
the frozen route derives identity from the server mapping only
current release requires the mapped current principal, project, source, root, path, item permission
exact history accepts only one governed (repository, commit, path) locator
exact history additionally requires a versioned historical-release manifest covering principal/project, exact locator and classification
current visibility, repository reachability, a current receipt or semantic match cannot substitute
exact-history receipts bind bases/versions/hashes, decisions, mapped identity/scope, locator, classification, blob hash/time, evaluation time and audit id
missing, ambiguous, drifted, stale, denied or mismatched bases return non-enumerating UNKNOWN/unauthorized before body release
the frozen persistent-MCP candidate satisfies the full identity/mapping, receipt and exact-history contract on the wire
content-free artifact names owner repository/version, commands, schema/corpus/identity, matrices, receipt fields, no-write result, adapter candidates and final handshake
owner artifact validates independently and owner-native tests pass
permission denial occurs before evidence/body work and produces the safe non-enumerating state
current/history, time, freshness, role/basis and exact-reference receipts map losslessly or fail closed
REC-08 crash/version/schema/corpus/timeout/cancel cases behave deterministically
repeated current queries re-read lee-kb; an older observation cannot satisfy them
one production route is live; direct-store fallback, dual-route code and historical search/cache are absent

determinism.normalized_command_output: command digests hash normalized output: wall-clock durations, absolute temporary/repository/home paths, timestamps and 32+ hex digests are replaced with stable tokens
determinism.stable_body_scope: stable_body_sha256 covers the artifact minus volatile_fields and is reproducible on the same toolchain; pytest and Python versions are part of it, so it is machine-specific

identity_mapping.mapping_hash_scope: identity fields with an empty grant tuple

current.expectation: authenticated principal lee maps server-side to lee@leebase.com with no client groups
any principal other than the mapped one is denied without enumeration
no wire argument can carry principal, groups, grants or scope; every tool schema is closed
a request cannot select a project that is not explicitly granted
source namespace, root, path and item outside the server grant are refused
multi-project mapping needs an explicit project and yields per-project grants
current release requires the mapped principal plus the granted source, root, path, and item
the owner slice exposes a supported current-release entry point the adapter can call
the owner slice publishes every version, the mapping hash, and the permission and receipt versions the consumer compares
the frozen stdio route derives identity from the server mapping, not from configuration
initialize publishes the owner handshake, so the frozen route can see owner-side version drift
a repeated current query re-reads lee-kb and produces a new receipt

history.expectation: only an exact (repository, commit, path) locator is accepted; patterns and refs are refused
exactly one governed locator per call, with a closed wire schema
a doubly authorized exact locator releases the immutable body with a receipt
the exact-history receipt binds bases, versions, hashes, locator, blob hash/time, evaluation time and audit id
no versioned historical-release manifest means non-enumerating UNKNOWN and no body
a classification the manifest does not cover returns UNKNOWN and no body
a locator the manifest does not cover returns UNKNOWN and no body
ambiguous manifest coverage fails closed to UNKNOWN
an expired manifest fails closed to UNKNOWN
a stale historical basis fails closed to UNKNOWN
a denied historical basis returns the unauthorized state with no body
current permission is required for history and the body seam is never touched without it
repository reachability cannot substitute: without the exact-object seam there is no body
the supported exact-object seam reads one allowlisted named object and refuses everything else
a locator path outside the server grant is unauthorized before the body seam
an unmapped principal gets UNKNOWN with no receipt and no body seam call
a non-KNOWN result cannot structurally carry a body
the history seam has no search or cache input; timeout/cancel are not owner-side concerns
no historical search or cache tool exists beside the exact-reference tool
the frozen stdio route releases an authorized exact-history body with a complete receipt
every withheld basis answers identically over the frozen route, with no body and no receipt
the frozen stdio route rejects any extra client argument, so transport cannot confer identity

provenance.content_free: no source content, question text, corpus path lists or evidence bodies are included; only lee-kb's own root-relative file names, symbol names, test ids, schema key names, digests, counts and booleans
provenance.evidence_basis: every matrix row is computed from an in-process behaviour probe, a focused pytest run and, where a rule must be test-defended, a mutation probe applied to a private copy of the package
